description: This file defines the `ConnectionProperties` interface which declares methods related to serial port connection settings such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and timeouts.

classes.name: ConnectionProperties
classes.description: An interface specifying methods for serial connection properties such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and timeouts.

methods.name: getBaudRate
methods.description: Returns the current baud rate setting.

methods.name: setBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate to the specified value.

methods.name: getDataBits
methods.description: Returns the number of data bits.

methods.name: getStopBits
methods.description: Returns the number of stop bits.
